headline: Concor Enters Business Rescue Amid R1.6 Billion Liabilities
summary: South African construction company Concor entered business rescue as its contingent liabilities on current projects exceed R1.6 billion, while cash and receivables total just R15,000.
why: Business rescue procedures allow financially distressed companies to restructure under supervision, directly impacting creditors, employees, and ongoing construction projects.

impacts.name: Concor
impacts.why: Entering business rescue indicates severe financial distress for the company.
